items.title: Mike Macdonald on Joe Mixon: "Didn't work out"

items.title: Lane Johnson's retirement could create a cap mess for the Eagles in 2027
items.text: Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson said in August that 2026 will probably be his last year.

items.title: 49ers WR Mike Evans limited in Wednesday's practice
items.text: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans played through an injury to his ribs, catching five passes for 76 yards.

items.title: Jesse Minter on Lamar Jackson: A lot of time between now and Sunday
items.text: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson didn't practice on Wednesday because of the ankle injury that has left doubt about whether he'll play against the Falcons this Sunday, but head coach Jesse Minter isn't ruling him out at this point.

items.title: Sean Payton: I "don't think" Patrick Surtain II, Pat Bryant will land on IR

items.title: Zay Flowers limited, Trey Hendrickson out at Ravens practice

items.title: Drake Maye is skeptical of the moon landing

items.title: John Harbaugh: Giants are "just not good enough" at generating explosive runs

items.title: Chargers RT Joe Alt did not practice Wednesday, not expected to play Sunday

items.title: Odell Beckham Jr.: Kevin O'Connell wanted me to be here
items.text: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell and new Vikings receiver Odell Beckham Jr. spent time together with the Rams, and they both have a Super Bowl ring from it.

items.title: Falcons LT Jake Matthews, DE Za'Darius Smith did not practice Wednesday
items.text: Falcons left tackle Jake Matthews made his 199th consecutive start on Monday night, the longest active streak in the NFL.

items.title: Justin Jefferson returns to practice, Jordan Addison sits out
items.text: The Vikings got Justin Jefferson back at practice on Wednesday, but another wideout was missing from the workout.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Don't know if extension is off the table, but there's a stalemate
items.text: A contract extension for Lions tight end Sam LaPorta may not be off the table, but it doesn't sound like the two sides are close to an agreement.

items.title: Ravens expect Cam Jurgens to be ready to play in Week 6
items.text: The Ravens traded for center Cam Jurgens on Wednesday, but it doesn't look like his debut for the team will come for another week.

items.title: Tyler Shough limited in practice with left hand injury
items.text: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough had his left hand hit in Monday night's loss to the Falcons but played all 74 snaps.

items.title: Seahawks DT Jarran Reed: Players hit penalty issues "head on" in meeting this week
items.text: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald called the team's seven personal fouls in last Sunday's win over the Chargers "unacceptable at any level" and his players didn't wait to go to work on cleaning things up this week.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers won't comment on whether play calls are coming in fast enough
items.text: After Thursday night's loss in Cleveland, Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers wasn't asked about his viral moment with coach Mike McCarthy, sparked by Rodgers's obvious frustration with the time it was taking to communicate the play call to the huddle.

items.title: Breece Hall remains out of practice for the Jets
items.text: The Jets called running back Breece Hall week-to-week after he suffered a quad injury in their Week 3 loss to the Lions and Wednesday's practice report gave reason to believe his return to action won't come this week.

items.title: Jalen Ramsey, Jamel Dean did not practice on Wednesday
items.text: The Steelers did not have a couple of defensive backs for Wednesday’s practice as they begin to get ready to face the Colts.

items.title: Patriots WR Mack Hollins hopes to practice later this week
items.text: Patriots wide receiver Mack Hollins did not practice on Wednesday, but he hopes to be back on the practice field later this week.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins among six Bengals out of practice

items.title: In joint statement, NFL and NFLPA say drinking celebrations will be permitted

items.title: Jayden Daniels up to full practice on Wednesday
items.text: Word last weekend was that Jayden Daniels's practice participation would determine whether he's able to return as the Commanders' starting quarterback against the Giants in Week 5 and Wednesday's injury report offers reason to believe he's moving in the right direction.
